children: Every bullet is a note. Click one to edit it; `Enter` starts the next note and `Tab` nests it under the one above.
Notes are **Markdown**: `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `` `code` ``, lists, tables and links.
Click a bullet to zoom into it, and the arrow beside it to fold its children away. `Ctrl + Z` undoes what you just did.
Type `[[` to link to a page, for example [[Getting started]]. A page you link to lists this note under its backlinks.
Every day has its own journal page; the calendar on the left takes you to any day.
`Ctrl + Space` finds or creates a page; `Shift + Space` searches all notes.
TODO Start a note with a task keyword to make it a task
DONE Tick the box to mark it done
Write properties anywhere in a note, like {priority::high} or {project::notd}. They make notes findable by search and queries.
`:d` followed by a space inserts today's date, `:t` a tag.
A query lists the notes it finds, for example all open tasks: `SQL{SELECT id FROM Notes WHERE content LIKE 'TODO %'}` (write it without the backticks).
Type `/` to insert a template. Paste or drop a file onto a note to attach it.
The ⚙ next to the page title renames, prints, exports, locks or deletes the page; the ☆ adds it to your favourites.
When you are done exploring, delete these notes: right-click a bullet and choose **Delete**.
